data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman name 'Maurus', meaning 'dark-skinned'. In Christian context, it's associated with Saint Maurus. The name Mauro carries the meaning “Maurice, Dark-skinned” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mauro usually hope their child will grow to embody maurice, dark-skinned and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mauro total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Mauro has its origins in the Latin word "Maurus," which means 'dark-skinned.' Historically, it was a common name in the Roman Empire and has been used throughout Europe, particularly in Italy and Spain, where the Latin influence was strong. In modern times, the name Mauro has been adopted by people of various ethnic backgrounds.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, the name Mauro is associated with Saint Maurus, a holy martyr who is renowned for his deep faith and endurance during persecution. According to legend, St. Maurus was a Roman soldier who, along with his companions, Tranquillinus and Marcellinus, converted to Christianity and was martyred during the persecutions of Emperor Valerian in the 3rd century AD. The name Mauro, in its spiritual significance, represents the deep faith and unwavering commitment to Christianity, symbolized by the association with the saint's name.
